description: Exact port of nera-data-layer bootstrap_eager_resolve at 2b1504adc4291daaf080b2e932962b134da1a69a.

stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,NULL AS alias,NULL AS module,NULL AS value,NULL AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(ast_breadth_order,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(ast_index,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,NULL AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,NULL AS context,ast_name_repr AS name_repr,NULL AS value_repr,NULL AS annotation,NULL AS annotation_repr FROM canonical

stages.name: calls
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.name AS callee,f.id AS callee_id,r.id AS receiver,r.kind AS receiver_kind,r.name AS receiver_name
      FROM a c JOIN a f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.parent=c.id AND f.field='func'
      LEFT JOIN a r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.parent=f.id AND r.field='value'
      WHERE c.kind='Call'

stages.name: iterations
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE it(__path,root,id) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,v.id FROM a n JOIN a v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id AND v.field='iter' WHERE n.kind IN ('For','AsyncFor')
 UNION ALL SELECT it.__path,it.root,v.id FROM it JOIN calls c ON c.__path=it.__path AND c.id=it.id
 JOIN a v ON v.__path=c.__path AND v.parent=c.id AND v.field='args' AND v.position=0 WHERE c.callee_kind='Name' AND c.callee IN ('list','tuple','set','sorted'))
 SELECT n.*,v.name AS iter_name,v.name_repr AS iter_repr FROM it JOIN a v ON v.__path=it.__path AND v.id=it.id JOIN a n ON n.__path=it.__path AND n.id=it.root WHERE v.kind='Name'

relational.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'BLB-001' AS issue,'bootstrap full query_lazy(...).execute_lazy() must move to proof/keyed SQL before hard-fail' AS message,n.id||':BLB-001:'||(n.bfs) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.bfs AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM calls n WHERE n.callee_kind='Attribute' AND n.callee='execute_lazy' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calls r WHERE r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.receiver AND r.callee_kind='Attribute' AND r.callee='query_lazy') UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'BLB-004' AS issue,'bootstrap eager schema probe '||n.callee||' must route through BootstrapScopeProof providers' AS message,n.id||':BLB-004:'||(n.bfs) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.bfs AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM calls n WHERE n.callee IN ('physical_table_exists_many','physical_table_exists_many_async','table_exists_many','table_exists_many_async','table_exists_many_for_schema_batch','table_exists_many_for_schema_batch_async') UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'BLB-003' AS issue,'bootstrap/server-plan Python model materializer '||n.callee||' must stay out of lowering paths' AS message,n.id||':BLB-003:'||(n.bfs) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.bfs AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM calls n WHERE n.callee_kind='Attribute' AND n.callee IN ('model_dump','model_copy') UNION ALL SELECT n.__path AS path,n.__start AS start_byte,n.__end AS end_byte,n.line,'BLB-002' AS issue,'bootstrap Python row iteration over '||n.iter_repr||' must move to SQL/proof-owned matching' AS message,n.id||':BLB-002:'||(n.bfs) AS identity,0 AS phase,n.bfs AS ordering,'' AS symbol,'' AS sort_name FROM iterations n WHERE n.iter_name IN ('existing_rows','generation_rows','manifest_rows','rows','schema_state_rows','system_session_rows')) WHERE instr(path,'bootstrap')>0
